blocks.text: Regardless of the identity provider (IdP) you configure for single sign-on (SSO), the following best practices apply.
Zscaler recommends you are aware of the following best practices for user SSO:

blocks.item: If you also use Zscaler Client Connector for Internet & SaaS, authentication into Zscaler Client Connector for internet access should also use SAML and ideally the same IdP as Private Access (ZPA) to avoid having the user log in twice.
It is not possible to associate a Private Access account to a Zscaler Client Connector account on different clouds.
If Internet & SaaS and Private Access are using the same IdP, then users can access applications through Private Access using Zscaler Client Connector or Browser Access.

If the IdPs in Private Access are not being used by Internet & SaaS, authentication domains must be configured in Private Access. Zscaler Client Connector does not require these domains. As a result, users can access applications through Private Access using Browser Access only.

If the authentication domain associated with the IdP configured in Private Access is not associated with the IdP configured in Internet & SaaS, users will see an error when using that domain for authentication in Internet & SaaS.

blocks.text: If you are configuring your IdP for admin SSO, make sure that a Private Access admin account exists and that NameID in the SAML assertion matches the admin account.

blocks.heading: Best Practices for Configuring Multiple IdPs

blocks.text: Zscaler recommends configuring multiple IdPs for:

blocks.item: Users that are authenticating via Browser Access and do not require Zscaler Client Connector.
Organizations who are using Zscaler Client Connector only for Private Access.

blocks.text: To learn more, see About IdP Configuration.
Zscaler recommends editing the existing IdP to migrate to a new IdP. Adding a new IdP for migration can duplicate groups and departments, and your existing policies might no longer apply.
To learn more, see Migrating to a New IdP Configuration.
